## Football effect

Poyer finished the game: the record logs the injury at the end of Detroit's possession at 4:39 of the second quarter with no removal, and he played the third-quarter block (the interception of Orlovsky's throw to Ebron, returned 27 yards) and the fourth-quarter block with pairing C, plus the kickoff coverage (two tackles). The instruction after the game was out; he missed the August 23 review and install and the August 25 padded practice, was reassessed August 23 with no change and cleared August 26, his projected date, taking part normally in the August 26 padded practice and the August 27 walkthrough at the nickel and on the kickoff-coverage unit. He is available for the August 28 game and is at the nickel in Stone's frozen plan, by the plan's starting-defense structure and not as a new role. Four elapsed days, two practices missed, no game missed. The nickel work in the three games (53, then 47 defensive snaps, no recorded substitution fault) stands as recorded. No role change follows and no football finding attaches to the instruction.
